items.stem: Why can you NOT see anything in a completely dark, sealed room?

options.text: There is no light reaching your eyes from the objects
options.rationale: Correct: we see only when light reaches our eyes; with no light there is nothing to see.

options.text: Your eyes stop working in the dark
options.rationale: Your eyes still work; there is simply no light to detect.

options.text: The objects disappear in the dark
options.rationale: Objects are still there; they just are not lit.
Eyesight is not absorbed; seeing just needs light.

items.explanation: Correct: we see only when light reaches our eyes; with no light there is nothing to see.
